ina240_ds.title: INA240 -4-V to 80-V, Bidirectional, Ultra-Precise Current Sense Amplifier With Enhanced PWM Rejection
ina240_ds.note: 39 pages. Pages 1-26 carry a printed page number equal to the PDF page; 27-39 are unnumbered addendum pages: packaging information (pp.27-29, which list INA240A1D as SOIC (D) 8, tube, and INA240A1DR as reel), tape and reel (pp.30-32), the SOIC D0008A drawing with its land pattern (pp.33-35), the TSSOP PW0008A drawing (pp.36-38) and the legal notice (p.39). The PDF title says Rev. C and the addendum is dated 10/2025; the PDF was generated 2026-08-11. The text layer is clean for prose and tables (micro sign as µ, minus signs as en dashes, which library_quotes.py normalizes). Figure labels in a symbol font extract garbled: the '100 mΩ' shunt in Figure 9-3 reads '100 PŸ', the 'DON'T' in Figure 9-7 reads ''21¶7', and the Figure 9-2 axis 'µA' reads 'PA'; claims that rely on figures cite them with `figure` descriptions read off a rendering. The page-1 features and description run in two columns, so -layout text interleaves them; plain pdftotext reads them in order.
